//: This is the manifest file for the CLIENT side of the app (the Vue frontend).
npm reads this file to know:
• What third-party packages to download (dependencies / devDependencies)
When you run 'npm install', npm reads this file and downloads everything
listed here into the local 'node_modules/' folder.
• axios: HTTP client library — used to make API requests to the backend.
• pinia: State management library for Vue — holds shared app data.
• vue: The core Vue 3 framework UI library.
• @vitejs/plugin-vue: Tells Vite how to handle .vue components.
• autoprefixer: Automatically adds browser vendor prefixes to CSS.
• postcss: Tool that transforms CSS (needed by Tailwind).
• vite: The build tool and development server.
